impact: VAL-CAP-004 (must-pass, §22 row 4) fails with 0.771104 drop rate (40-47 drops/second, all 58 samples non-zero) against maxDropRate=0 threshold. Last known-good run (2026-05-22T02-21-35-097Z, T-021 rerun-27) showed 0.000000 drop rate with identical hardware. Blocks T-010c §22 smoke at row 4. Cadence (54.0 fps) and resolution (1920x1080) pass normally — only drop rate fails. pipewire.rs has not changed since 6371f46 (pre-T-021 rerun-27); capture code path is unchanged. Possible causes: (a) PipeWire/KWin compositor behavior change between 2026-05-22 and 2026-05-25 (system updates, compositor state), (b) back-pressure from helper changes in 927bf0d (ISS-012 watchdog, export/mod.rs) or 1f558ae (ISS-015 overlap fix, segment/buffer.rs) slowing buffer writes and causing encoder back-pressure. Drop pattern is systematic (not intermittent), consistent across all 58 seconds. System load at test time: kwin_wayland 9.5% CPU, firefox 8.5%, baloo_file 7.3% (indexer active). Evidence: validation-artifacts/smoke/2026-05-25T08-56-46-064Z/VAL-CAP-004/ (thresholds.json, capture-diagnostics.json, env-probe.json).
